Roth.exists_auxiliary_polynomial_of_log_bound_aux✝ {f : Polynomial ℤ} {α A : ℝ} (hf : f.Monic)
  (hfα : (Polynomial.aeval α) f = 0) (hA : ∀ (i : ℕ), |↑(f.coeff i)| ≤ A) {m q₁ r₁ : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (r : Fin m → ℕ)
  (hr : ∀ (j : Fin m), 0 < r j) (hs : ∑ j, r j ≤ m * r₁) {δ : ℝ} (hδ0 : 0 ≤ δ)
  (hL : 2 * ↑m + 1 + 2 * ↑m * Real.log (1 + A) + 2 * ↑m * Real.log (1 + |α|) ≤ δ ^ 2 * Real.log ↑q₁) :
  ∃ P ∈ Roth.RSet (↑q₁ ^ (δ * ↑r₁)) r,
    Roth.gam δ f.natDegree m ≤ Roth.index ((map (Int.castRingHom ℝ)) P) (fun x ↦ α) r ∧
      ∀ (i k : Fin m →₀ ℕ),
        |(eval fun x ↦ α) ((map (Int.castRingHom ℝ)) ((hasseDeriv i) ((hasseDeriv k) P)))| <
          ↑(Roth.mainCoeffBound δ q₁ r₁) ^ (1 + 3 * δ)

private theorem Roth.exists_auxiliary_polynomial_of_log_bound_aux : ∀ {f : Polynomial ℤ} {α A : ℝ},

        ∀ {m q₁ r₁ : ℕ},
          0 < m →
            ∀ (r : Fin m → ℕ),
              (∀ (j : Fin m), 0 < r j) →
                ∑ j, r j ≤ m * r₁ →
                  ∀ {δ : ℝ},
                    0 ≤ δ →
                      2 * ↑m + 1 + 2 * ↑m * Real.log (1 + A) + 2 * ↑m * Real.log (1 + |α|) ≤ δ ^ 2 * Real.log ↑q₁ →
                        ∃ P ∈ Roth.RSet (↑q₁ ^ (δ * ↑r₁)) r,
                          Roth.gam δ f.natDegree m ≤ Roth.index ((map (Int.castRingHom ℝ)) P) (fun x ↦ α) r ∧
                            ∀ (i k : Fin m →₀ ℕ),
                              |(eval fun x ↦ α) ((map (Int.castRingHom ℝ)) ((hasseDeriv i) ((hasseDeriv k) P)))| <
                                ↑(Roth.mainCoeffBound δ q₁ r₁) ^ (1 + 3 * δ) :=
fun {f} {α A} hf hfα hA {m q₁ r₁} hm r hr hs {δ} hδ0 hL ↦
  let B := Roth.mainCoeffBound δ q₁ r₁;
  let β := ↑B ^ δ;
  Exists.casesOn
    (Roth.exists_mem_RSet_le_index_of_log_bound_aux✝ hf hfα hA hm r hr hs hδ0
      (LE.le.trans
        (le_add_of_nonneg_right

              (mul_pos
                (Mathlib.Meta.Positivity.pos_of_isNat (Mathlib.Meta.NormNum.isNat_ofNat ℝ (Eq.refl 2))
                  (Eq.refl (Nat.ble 1 2)))
                (Nat.cast_pos'.mpr hm)))
            (Real.log_nonneg (le_add_of_nonneg_right (abs_nonneg α)))))
        hL))
    fun P h ↦

                        (le_of_lt
                          (Mathlib.Meta.Positivity.pos_of_isNat (Mathlib.Meta.NormNum.isNat_ofNat ℝ (Eq.refl 3))
                            (Eq.refl (Nat.ble 1 3))))
                        hδ0))))
                (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a ↦ _a * ↑B ^ (3 * δ) = ↑B * β ^ 3) (Real.rpow_one ↑B)))
                  (Eq.mpr

                      (congrArg (fun _a ↦ ↑B * ↑B ^ (3 * δ) = ↑B * _a)
